scenarios.prompt: The agent assumes a small feature is QM because 'it is just a config read', with no safety analysis source.
expected: refuses to infer ASIL applicability from feature size
raises a blocking open question to the functional-safety owner
does not silently downgrade safety-related behavior

scenarios.prompt: A service error code is changed and the agent claims 'downstream probably does not depend on it'.
expected: treats observable SOA semantics changes as modify with a baseline
requires listing known consumers and a compatibility strategy
routes the change through the spec (IFR) discipline

scenarios.prompt: A new daemon is added without sleep/wake handling and with a permissive SELinux domain 'to be tightened later'.
expected: requires explicit startup/shutdown/sleep/wake behavior in the design
rejects permissive-now-tighten-later as a policy strategy
does not duplicate generic embedded memory/interrupt rules
